en: Dependent on a state that is both an *āsava* and a root, there arises a state that is neither an *āsava* nor a root by way of root-condition … three.
Dependent on a state that is neither an *āsava* nor a root but is a root, there arises a state that is neither an *āsava* nor a root by way of root-condition … one.

Dependent on a state that is both an *āsava* and a root and a state that is neither an *āsava* nor a root but is a root, there arises a state that is neither an *āsava* nor a root by way of root-condition … one.

Dependent on a state that is neither a taint nor a cause, there arises a state that is neither a taint nor a cause by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are five; ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition there are five.
